title: Finding an accessible room

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: The center prints a new map tomorrow. Today, use the room letter from the access table, not the old map screenshot.
turns.zh: 中心明天會印新版地圖。今天以出入資訊表的房間代號為準，不要用舊地圖截圖。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: Someone’s bringing a keyboard on a wide stand. It won’t fit through a narrow door or go up steps.
turns.zh: 有人會帶一台架在寬琴架上的電子琴。這套器材過不了窄門，也搬不上階梯。

turns.speaker: F
turns.text: Pick a room that meets both needs, then send me its letter.
turns.zh: 選一間符合兩項需求的房間，再把房間代號傳給我。

turns.speaker: M
turns.text: I’ve already sent everyone the start time. I’ll send the room letter separately.
turns.zh: 開始時間我已經通知大家，房間代號會另外傳。
